results.title: ChatGPT Chat vs. Work vs. Agents vs. Dots Explained
results.content:
These are practical distinctions, not rigid categories. An agent can perform several kinds of work, and different experiences may use related underlying models. The model and the way the product organizes work are separate considerations. OpenAI Help Center

## Chat vs. Work: What Changes?

The main difference is how you direct the work. In Chat, the conversation is usually the center of the experience. In Work, the conversation directs a larger assignment that the system can carry out for your review. OpenAI recommends Chat for questions and conversational help, and Work for substantial tasks and finished deliverables. OpenAI

### Chat: Ask, discuss, and refine [...] Use Chat as your starting point for questions, explanations, analysis, and collaborative drafting.

Consider Work or a comparable execution tool when the assignment requires gathering information, working across applications, or producing a finished deliverable.

Consider a workspace agent when a useful process should be configured once and reused by colleagues.

Consider a dot when the value lies in keeping an ongoing responsibility moving and connecting new information to existing work.

And check the AI features already inside your software before building a separate workflow around a task that the application may already handle well. [...] Work can also run on a schedule or supported event trigger. It is not limited to one-time assignments, and it is available on eligible personal paid plans as well as organizational plans. You do not need ChatGPT Business simply to use Work. OpenAI Help Center

### Is Work the same as Agent mode?

OpenAI previously offered a product called ChatGPT Agent mode. Its current Help Center notice says that experience is no longer available and directs users to Work. OpenAI Help Center

However, agent also describes a broader kind of AI system that performs tasks. Work is an agent, and so is a dot. Therefore, “agent” does not always mean a separate mode. Workspace agents, discussed next, are another specific product feature—not simply the old Agent mode under a different name. OpenAI Help Center

results.content:
Chat, channels, meetings and Microsoft 365 file collaboration in one connected workspace.

## 4. Google Chat — Best for Google Workspace Users

Google Chat is a straightforward work chat app for businesses already using Google Workspace.

It connects naturally with Gmail, Google Drive, Docs, Sheets, Calendar and Meet, making it easy for employees to chat about files and projects without moving between separate platforms.

Best For

- Businesses using Google Workspace
- Small and growing teams that want simple internal messaging
- Remote teams working in Google Docs, Drive and Meet
- Organisations looking for a lightweight alternative to more complex chat tools

Key Features [...] ## What Are Work Chat Apps, Exactly?

Workplace chat apps are business messaging tools that help employees communicate quickly during the working day.

They usually support one-to-one messages, group conversations, topic-based channels, file sharing, reactions and, in many cases, voice or video calls.

Think of them as a faster alternative to sending an email for every small question. Someone can ask for an update, share a document, check availability or solve a customer issue without starting a long email thread.

However, work chat apps are not the same as personal messaging apps such as WhatsApp. Personal apps can be convenient, but they often lack the permissions, search, message retention and security controls businesses need. [...] - The best work chat apps help employees communicate faster, share files, coordinate everyday tasks and find useful information without relying on crowded email inboxes.
- Slack, Microsoft Teams and Google Chat are strong choices for businesses that want team messaging connected to their existing workplace software.
- AgilityPortal, Workvivo, Staffbase, Blink and Beekeeper are better suited to organisations that need work chats alongside employee news, policies, documents and frontline communication.
- Free group chat apps for work can be useful for small teams, but businesses should check limits on message history, storage, mobile access, integrations, security and administration controls.
